summary: The clips of “snowboy” from the `picovoice-snowboy` test set, placed between seconds of read speech, followed by hours of audio with no wake word. A detector streams every recording and is scored on the wake words it caught and on how often per hour it woke with no wake word.
notes: Built by scripts/publish_ww_stream_bench.py from `picovoice-snowboy` at Picovoice/wake-word-benchmark@f047dd73 (400 of 401 clips with the phrase) and the shared negative recordings.
